description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the enterprise security foundation for AI agents used in demanding engineering environments, including regulated settings. As a senior, hands-on individual contributor reporting to the CTO, you will shape the security architecture and ship core controls across the agent runtime, desktop application, backend services, and engineering integrations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the threat model, map trust boundaries and data flows, prioritize risks, and define testable security criteria for supported deployments.

 - Secure agent execution by integrating sandboxing and approval controls, and building policies that constrain generated code, privileged tools, native actions, and extensions.

 - Implement scoped capabilities, resource permissions, and operation-specific approvals that keep agent actions within the user's and organization's authority.

 - Build secure service boundaries, short-lived credential handling, enterprise identity integrations, tenant isolation, and controls for network egress, storage, retention, and deletion.

 - Create auditable action records and approval receipts, and ensure sensitive operations fail safely when required services are unavailable.

 - Harden desktop integrations, packaging, updates, and releases, and design customer-hosted or restricted-network deployment profiles.

 - Write adversarial and integration tests, investigate vulnerabilities, enforce release security checks, support incident response, and document controls for customer reviews.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Four to ten years of software engineering experience, including at least one year in security software engineering securing desktop applications or similar products.

 - Evidence of personally taking complex production systems from design through implementation, rollout, and maintenance, including shipping enforceable security controls.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, operating systems, and systems design.

 - Experience with Python backends or runtimes, TypeScript desktop applications, or Rust systems software; familiarity with AI agent runtimes, developer tools, and tool protocols is valuable.

 - Relevant experience may include authorization, secrets, process isolation, permissions, network boundaries, secure execution, desktop sandboxing, enterprise identity, or restricted-network deployments.

 - Ability to own an ambiguous security roadmap while remaining a hands-on contributor; engineering tools and sensitive or regulated workflows are relevant domains.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $330,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week.
